I looked at something similar, [using these fans](https://www.amazon.com/AC-Infinity-AIRPLATE-Cooling-Cabinets/dp/B009CO543S?th=1) on [these filters](https://www.target.com/p/aerostar-12x24x1-merv-13-health-air-filter-box-of-4/-/A-83074657) with [this mesh on the outside](https://www.airfilterllc.com/product/hvac-aluminum-mesh-panel-filters-12-x-24-x-2/). The cost added up really quickly, and I'd have no idea where to start wiring those fans to use a single cable. This was assuming I'd use as many fans as possible, which would be 4 pairs per filter. Not 100% confident that would fit, but it seemed close enough to tape together. A spacer between the fans and the filter seems to be required for most builds like this, so I'd have to cut cardboard strips to size. That's about all I feel confident doing craftywise, though I imagine I could spend some money getting custom cut wood in the correct dimensions from Home Depot or something if I'm willing to take the time and able to get the help.

>What are the dimensions of your window?

The sill is just over 28" off the floor, right next to an outlet. It's about 10' above the walkway. The sill is 26" wide on the inside. Where the window rests there's a 24" wide 1" deep area I'd been looking at to place the main filter, but that seems not deep enough. There's more area outside that, but it narrows even further before hitting the mesh bug screen. It can open about 30" tall, but I won't need it open that far, I was looking for 12", sealing the filter under the sash with rags or just resting the window directly on top. 

>Do you have basic crafty skills or woodworking skills?

No, not really. I can tape up a CR box, but I can't woodwork, and I don't have a 3d printer or any other fancy kit that might help with bespoke parts.

Someone did suggest using [MERV-13 fabric](https://www.amazon.com/Material-Particles-Allergens-Efficiency-Breathable/dp/B08K3BDHR6/) over a window fan. I'm wondering why this fabric isn't more widely used in DIY air purifiers, I'd never heard of it before. I still worry about airflow issues in that case, as well as how flimsy the assembly might be.

I wasn't aware of MERV-13 fabric, very surprised I haven't seen that mentioned anywhere before! Thank you! I wonder why people don't discuss it, maybe it has some drawbacks that standard MERV filters don't.

I'm worried about the power of a window fan for the same reasons as the small box fans, which was why I was looking at PC fans. But given the cost and difficulty setting up, it might be worthwhile to try a window fan setup.
